parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const eventType=String(b.eventType??b.type??'financial_reconciliation').trim().toLowerCase(); const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const assignmentId=String(b.assignmentId??'').trim(); const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const idempotencyKey=String(b.idempotencyKey??('financials:'+eventType+':'+leadId+':'+dealId+':'+assignmentId+':'+(b.settlementId??b.eventId??''))).trim(); return [{json:{...b,eventType,leadId,propertyId,dealId,assignmentId,portfolioId,idempotencyKey,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Financial Analytics Event').first().json; const c=$json.context??$json; const n=x=>Number.isFinite(Number(x))?Number(x):0; const grossRevenue=n(c.grossRevenue??c.assignmentFee??input.assignmentFee); const purchasePrice=n(c.purchasePrice??input.purchasePrice); const closingCosts=n(c.closingCosts??input.closingCosts); const otherCosts=n(c.otherCosts??input.otherCosts); const acquisitionSpend=Math.max(0,n(c.acquisitionSpend??input.acquisitionSpend)); const totalCosts=purchasePrice+closingCosts+otherCosts; const netProfit=grossRevenue-totalCosts; const ownerSharePct=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,n(c.ownerSharePct??input.ownerSharePct??100))); const reservePct=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,n(c.reservePct??input.reservePct??0))); const ownerDistribution=netProfit*(ownerSharePct/100)*(1-reservePct/100); const reserveAmount=netProfit*(ownerSharePct/100)*(reservePct/100); const recordedDistribution=n(c.recordedOwnerDistribution??input.recordedOwnerDistribution); const distributionDelta=recordedDistribution-ownerDistribution; const roi=acquisitionSpend>0?netProfit/acquisitionSpend:null; const margin=grossRevenue>0?netProfit/grossRevenue:null; const closedDealCount=Math.max(0,n(c.closedDealCount??1)); const profitableDeals=netProfit>0?Math.max(1,n(c.profitableDeals??1)):Math.max(0,n(c.profitableDeals??0)); const flags=[]; if(grossRevenue<0)flags.push('invalid_gross_revenue'); if(totalCosts<0)flags.push('invalid_total_costs'); if(Math.abs(distributionDelta)>0.01)flags.push('owner_distribution_mismatch'); if(netProfit<0)flags.push('negative_net_profit'); const decision=flags.includes('invalid_gross_revenue')||flags.includes('invalid_total_costs')?'blocked':Math.abs(distributionDelta)>0.01?'reconciliation_required':netProfit<0?'loss_review':'reconciled'; const periods=Math.max(1,Math.min(12,Math.floor(n(c.forecastPeriods??1)))); const projectedClosedDeals=Math.max(0,n(c.projectedClosedDeals??closedDealCount*periods)); const projectedNetProfit=n(c.projectedNetProfit??netProfit*periods); const projectedRevenue=n(c.projectedRevenue??grossRevenue*periods); const projectedAcquisitionSpend=n(c.projectedAcquisitionSpend??acquisitionSpend*periods); const projectedRoi=projectedAcquisitionSpend>0?projectedNetProfit/projectedAcquisitionSpend:null; return [{json:{...input,canonicalFinancialsAnalytics:{grossRevenue,purchasePrice,closingCosts,otherCosts,totalCosts,netProfit,ownerSharePct,reservePct,ownerDistribution,reserveAmount,recordedDistribution,distributionDelta,acquisitionSpend,roi,profitMargin:margin,closedDealCount,profitableDeals,lossDeals:netProfit<0?1:0,winRate:closedDealCount>0?profitableDeals/closedDealCount:null,decision,flags,forecastPeriods:periods,projectedClosedDeals,projectedNetProfit,projectedRevenue,projectedAcquisitionSpend,projectedRoi},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.purpose: Canonical boundary combining post-closing financial reconciliation, owner distribution, closed-deal KPIs, ROI and forecasting. Historical WF-390 through WF-451 are reference implementations.
